{{Quote|Over here!|Unidentified Stormtrooper Searcher to another stormtrooper|<ref name="Empire Day" />}}
Stationed on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]], a '''stormtrooper''' was tasked to hunt down a [[Rodian]] fugitive named [[Tseebo]]. During the search, he was with another [[stormtrooper]], who was searching for the [[Spectres]] during the [[Empire Day]] celebration.<ref name="Empire Day" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The stormtrooper was voiced by [[Steve Blum]], who voiced [[Garazeb Orrelios]] in ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''.
